We work with tempered, laminated, and insulated glass units to restore your door to full function and appearance. sections.heading: Storefront Door Frame and Hardware Repair
sections.body: A glass panel is only as secure as the frame and hardware holding it in place. Misaligned door frames, worn-out pivots, failing closers, and damaged threshold plates are among the most common issues our commercial clients face. Left unaddressed, these problems accelerate wear on the glass itself and can compromise the security of your entire entrance system. Our technicians are trained to service and replace a wide range of commercial door hardware, including panic bars, overhead closers, pivot hinges, and multipoint locking mechanisms. Property managers overseeing mixed-use developments near the City of Falls Church civic core rely on us for prompt, professional hardware service that minimizes tenant disruption. We work efficiently around your business hours whenever possible, completing repairs during early morning or evening windows to avoid impacting customer-facing operations. Proper hardware function also supports smooth, consistent door operation, reducing the risk of further glass breakage caused by slamming or misalignment.
